name: The inhabited forest
description: The belief that forests, old trees and mounds are home to spirits whose leave is asked.
sources: Maximo D. Ramos, The Creatures of Philippine Lower Mythology (University of the Philippines Press, 1971)
William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)

lore.en: Across the lowland Philippines, forests, old trees and mounds were believed to be home to spirits. Before clearing land or passing a spirit's place, people asked leave: in Tagalog, 'tabi-tabi po'. Those who did not might fall sick or have bad luck. The belief taught care for places that were not only people's own.
lore.fil: Sa buong kapatagan ng Pilipinas, pinaniniwalaang tahanan ng mga espiritu ang gubat, matatandang puno at punso. Bago maglinis ng lupa o dumaan sa tirahan ng espiritu, humihingi ng pahintulot ang mga tao: sa Tagalog, 'tabi-tabi po'. Ang hindi gumagawa nito ay maaaring magkasakit o malasin. Itinuro ng paniniwalang ito ang pag-iingat sa mga lugar na hindi lamang sa tao.

inGame.en: Forest Balance falls as you clear forest and recovers slowly. Ask permission at the Dambana before clearing, and replant cleared land, to keep the spirits at peace.
inGame.fil: Bumababa ang Forest Balance habang naglilinis ng gubat at dahan-dahang bumabalik. Humingi ng pahintulot sa Dambana bago maglinis at magtanim muli upang manatiling payapa ang mga espiritu.

hint.en: Clear a lot of forest, or ask the spirits' leave.
hint.fil: Maglinis ng maraming gubat, o humingi ng pahintulot sa mga espiritu.
